name: Sasaki Chikako
source:
An energetic 2nd year high school student. She's courageous but acts before thinking. The hair ornament that Akari gave her 10 years ago is her greatest treasure.

[Translated from [url=https://ahonojuge00.wixsite.com/rinjou-stargazer]official website[/url]]
